jp: ガラクタの王冠を被った王様役で
en: Back then, you played the king, wearing a crown made of junk,

やったっていいんだぜ？

...Ngh

jp: 俺についた方がいいぜ？

jp: パスカどもをつれてくれば
en: ......Tch. Should've brought the Pasca along.
Luca, don't move.
...What now?
Look carefully. We're surrounded.
...Huh, a pretty sharp demon.
No wonder Bale and Kreis had trouble with you.

jp: とはいえこの私がかり出される
ほどのものとも思えんが

Two of them... when did they

かなり上級の天使みたいだな
en: ...Keh. Not the usual small-fry soldiers. These look like high-ranking angels.

今日は一流のみなさんが
ご同行下さっていますからね
en: Ahaha, I'm a second-rate angel, but today I've got first-rate company with me.

jp: 歳がらもなくよく回る舌だ
en: ...Hmph. A glib tongue, for one so young.

Rhipsalis!!

en: Given all that has passed between us, my feelings about this are mixed,

en: but this too is the Church's duty, so no hard feelings.
We're going too, Kreis.
Understood, my lord.
...Tch. Brute force, is it.
Don't worry. I won't kill you right away.

jp: せめて法の下で裁いてやる
en: Aragi, give it up. Surrender quietly, and at least you'll be judged under the law.
